correctAlternatives: {"files": [{"path": "solution.ts", "content": "type Range={start:number,end:number};export function mergeRanges(ranges:Range[]):Range[]{const a=ranges.map(r=>({...r})).sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start);const out:Range[]=[];for(const r of a){const last=out.at(-1);if(last&&r.start<=last.end)last.end=Math.max(last.end,r.end);else out.push(r);}return out;}"}]}

{"files": [{"path": "solution.ts", "content": "type R={start:number,end:number};export function mergeRanges(input:R[]):R[]{return [...input].sort((a,b)=>a.start-b.start).reduce<R[]>((acc,r)=>{const i=acc.length-1;if(i>=0&&acc[i]!.end>=r.start)acc[i]={start:acc[i]!.start,end:Math.max(acc[i]!.end,r.end)};else acc.push({...r});return acc;},[]);}"}]}
